panels.description: Detected from the OperationsManager database version. Unrecognised versions fall back to the latest adapter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ManagementGroupName AS "Management group",
       DBVersion AS "Database version",
       CASE WHEN DBVersion LIKE '10.19.%' THEN 'SCOM 2019'
            WHEN DBVersion LIKE '10.22.%' THEN 'SCOM 2022'
            WHEN DBVersion LIKE '10.25.%' THEN 'SCOM 2025'
            ELSE 'Unrecognised - latest adapter assumed' END AS "Detected product",
       CASE WHEN DBVersion LIKE '10.19.%' OR DBVersion LIKE '10.22.%' OR DBVersion LIKE '10.25.%'
            THEN 'adapter-' + SUBSTRING(DBVersion,1,5) ELSE 'adapter-default' END AS "Adapter"
FROM dbo.__MOMManagementGroupInfo__

panels.title: SCOM version detection (selects the data-layer adapter)

panels.description: Latest sample and state timestamps are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT g.ManagementGroupDefaultName AS "Management group",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.vManagementPack) AS "Management packs",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.vManagedEntity) AS "Managed entities",
       (SELECT MAX(DateTime) FROM Perf.vPerfRaw) AS "Latest perf sample (UTC)",
       (SELECT MAX(DateTime) FROM State.vStateRaw) AS "Latest state change (UTC)"
FROM dbo.vManagementGroup g WHERE g.OwnerManagementGroupInd = 1

panels.title: Management group and latest data

panels.description: MISSING means the corresponding dashboard pack will show no data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.Pack, p.Required AS "Required MP",
       CASE WHEN m.ManagementPackSystemName IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'Present' END AS Status
FROM (VALUES
  ('Windows Server','Microsoft.Windows.Server.Library'),
  ('Windows Server','Microsoft.Windows.Server.2016.Monitoring'),
  ('Active Directory','Microsoft.Windows.Server.AD.Class.Library'),
  ('Active Directory','Microsoft.Windows.Server.AD.2016.Monitoring'),
  ('SQL Server','Microsoft.SQLServer.Core.Library'),
  ('SQL Server','Microsoft.SQLServer.Windows.Monitoring')
) p(Pack, Required)
LEFT JOIN dbo.vManagementPack m ON m.ManagementPackSystemName = p.Required
ORDER BY p.Pack, p.Required

panels.title: Management Pack prerequisites for the dashboard packs

panels.description: Red or NO DATA means SCOM has stopped delivering data for that computer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.DisplayName AS Computer,
  (SELECT DATEDIFF(minute, MAX(p.DateTime), GETUTCDATE())
     FROM dbo.vManagedEntity c
     JOIN Perf.vPerfRaw p ON p.ManagedEntityRowId = c.ManagedEntityRowId
     WHERE c.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId = e.ManagedEntityRowId AND p.DateTime > DATEADD(day, -7, GETUTCDATE())) AS "Minutes since last perf sample",
  (SELECT DATEDIFF(minute, MAX(s.DateTime), GETUTCDATE())
     FROM dbo.vManagedEntity c
     JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityMonitor em ON em.ManagedEntityRowId = c.ManagedEntityRowId
     JOIN State.vStateRaw s ON s.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId = em.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId
     WHERE (c.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId = e.ManagedEntityRowId OR c.ManagedEntityRowId = e.ManagedEntityRowId)
       AND s.DateTime > DATEADD(day, -7, GETUTCDATE())) AS "Minutes since last state change"
FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId AND t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer'
WHERE e.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT e.DisplayName AS __text, e.DisplayName AS __value
FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer'
ORDER BY e.DisplayName
